subject: Re: Evidence for remediated pen-test items (BlueWave)
messages:
From: Ethan Reynolds <ethan.reynolds@bluewave.ai>
To: kimberly.park@redwood.ai
Cc: marcus.lin@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Pen test remediation — evidence request

Hi Kim,

Thanks again for walking our team through the remediation plan last week. BlueWave's external pentest report lists three medium findings that we flagged as requiring proof-of-fix before we close the ticket on our end (SSH config, KV service patch, and a token-handling flow). Can you share: 

- A screenshot or export of the updated sshd_config showing the disabled root login and updated ciphers
- The patch log or SCA report showing the KV service update (package+version)
- A short note on the compensating control for the token-handling issue and any follow-up tickets that track the work

If you can drop artifacts (screenshots, config snips, or Jira links) by EOD Wednesday 8/18 that would help expedite our closure.

Thanks,
Ethan
Ethan Reynolds
Security Engineer, BlueWave.ai
security@bluewave.ai

---
Attachment: bluewave-pt-findings-20260730.pdf (summary of findings)
From: kimberly.park@redwood.ai <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Ethan Reynolds <ethan.reynolds@bluewave.ai>
Cc: marcus.lin@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 09:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pen test remediation — evidence request

Ethan —

Appreciate the clear list. We're assembling the evidence now. Quick summary of what you'll see attached/shared: 

- SSH (sshd): disabled PermitRootLogin, disallowed legacy ciphers; screenshot exported from the host at 2026-08-12T02:15Z. See rw-sshd-config-20260812.png.
- KV service: patched from 2.3.1 -> 2.3.4; we ran the smoke suite and captured the package manager log (rw-kvservice-patch-20260810.log).
- Token flow: we implemented a short-lived refresh token policy and added server-side revocation indexed in Redis. As compensating control, we added a request-scoped token rotation with audit hooks; ledger and alerting are tracked in RED-1234.

I've uploaded the full artifact bundle to a shared Drive folder and exported the related Jira ticket as a PDF (see links below). For anything that needs stronger provenance (signed attestations, HSM audit), let me know and I can escalate to infra for signed logs.

Links/attachments included below. If you need the raw configs (not screenshots) I can provide sanitized copies.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Senior Manager, Customer Security
Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments:
- rw-sshd-config-20260812.png (PNG screenshot)
- rw-kvservice-patch-20260810.log (text log)
- rw-jira-redwood-RED-1234-export.pdf (Jira issue export)

Related links: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RED-1234, https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cExampleSharedEvidence
From: Ethan Reynolds <ethan.reynolds@bluewave.ai>
To: kimberly.park@redwood.ai
Cc: marcus.lin@redwood.ai, lauren.bishop@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 18 Aug 2026 14:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pen test remediation — evidence request

Kim / Marcus,

Thanks for the artifacts — we've reviewed the screenshots and the patch log. A couple of follow-ups before we mark the items closed on our side: 

1) For the SSH change, can you include the host OS release and a short attest line confirming this config is applied via your immutable infra pipeline (Terraform/Ansible/GitOps ref)? A simple snippet of the pipeline commit or apply job ID is fine.

2) For the KV service patch, could you paste the package manager output line that includes checksum or package signature (we need provenance of the binary), or point us to the internal artifact registry URL where the build image is stored?

3) For the token flow compensating control, would you confirm retention window for the revocation ledger and whether alerts are integrated into your SOC (pager duty or SIEM rule ID)?

If easier, a single consolidated PDF with screen captures and the two small config/job-id lines would be perfect. We can accept sensitive items via an SFTP drop if required.

Goal is to close by EOD Friday 8/20.

—Ethan
From: kimberly.park@redwood.ai <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Ethan Reynolds <ethan.reynolds@bluewave.ai>
Cc: lauren.bishop@redwood.ai, marcus.lin@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 19 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pen test remediation — evidence request

Ethan — quick update:

1) SSH: host OS: Ubuntu 22.04. Pipeline commit: git sha 8f4b2c9 — apply job ID: ci-redwood-deploy-20260812-77. I attached the pipeline job log excerpt in the Drive folder.

2) KV service: package checksum included (sha256: a3f5c9d2b7e8f1e4c6d0f3e9b1a2c4d5e6f7a8b9c0d1e2f3a4b5c6d7e8f9a0b1) and artifact registry URL: https://artifacts.redwood.internal/packages/kvservice/2.3.4

3) Token flow: revocation ledger retention = 90 days; alerts ship to SOC via SIEM rule ID SIEM-RED-402 and also create PagerDuty incidents for threshold breaches (PD service key redwood-soc). SOC confirmation: lauren.bishop@redwood.ai (copied) can provide attestation if you need formal sign-off.

I'll consolidate everything into a single PDF and drop it in the Drive folder by EOD today. If BlueWave prefers SFTP, we can use your dropbox; otherwise Drive link should be fine under the NDA.

Best,
Kimberly
